# diagprint v0.3.1 — Renderer & Theme System

# diagprint v0.3.1 — Renderer & Theme System

`v0.3.1` is a major terminal-rendering and theming upgrade for `diagprint`.

This release takes the terminal renderer from a functional prototype to a much more polished diagnostic UI with Unicode-aware layout, intelligent source clipping, wrapped annotations, regression tests, a public theme API, and optional Cybercore integration.

## Highlights

### Smarter terminal rendering

The terminal renderer now handles real-world diagnostic output much more gracefully:

* Unicode-aware display width
* Automatic terminal-width detection
* Message wrapping instead of blind truncation
* Wrapped causes, notes, help text, and metadata
* ANSI-safe width calculations
* Long unbroken tokens wrap correctly
* Better diagnostic box alignment

### Intelligent source diagnostics

Long source lines no longer hide the actual error location.

`diagprint` now keeps the highlighted region visible and clips the surrounding source intelligently:

```text
│ --> src/config.rs:42:18                                      │
│   41 │ let mode = read_mode();                               │
│ > 42 │ …configuration.set_mode(invalid_mode);                │
│      │                   ^^^^^^^^                             │
│      │                   └─ invalid configuration value      │
│   43 │ start_runtime();                                      │
```

Source rendering now includes:

* Highlight-following source windows
* Left/right ellipsis markers
* Target-line `>` gutter marker
* Unicode-aware caret placement
* Tab expansion
* Wrapped multiline source labels
* Cleaner source gutters

### Public theme system

`diagprint` now exposes a reusable theme API:

```rust
use diagprint::{Style, Theme};

let theme = Theme {
    border: Style::rgb(0, 255, 255).dim(),
    source_caret: Style::rgb(255, 0, 128).bold(),
    note: Style::rgb(255, 180, 0).bold(),
    help: Style::rgb(120, 255, 120).bold(),
    ..Theme::default()
};
```

New public types:

* `Theme`
* `Style`
* `SeverityTheme`

`Style` supports:

* True-color RGB foregrounds
* True-color RGB backgrounds
* ANSI-256 colors
* Hex RGB colors
* Bold
* Dim
* Italic
* Underline

Calling `.color(false)` still suppresses all ANSI styling regardless of the selected theme.

## Cybercore Integration

Cybercore support is now available behind the optional `cybercore` feature.

Use the active Cybercore theme:

```rust
let theme = Theme::cybercore();
```

Load a named theme:

```rust
let theme = Theme::cybercore_named("neon-night");
```

Safely fall back to the active theme:

```rust
let theme = Theme::cybercore_or_default("possibly-missing-theme");
```

Theme discovery is also available:

```rust
let names = Theme::cybercore_theme_names();
let active = Theme::cybercore_active_theme_name();

if Theme::cybercore_theme_exists("neon-night") {
    // ...
}
```

Cybercore remains the source of truth for palette data; `diagprint` does not maintain a duplicate palette registry.

### Cybercore showcase

A new example renders all diagnostic severities using the selected Cybercore theme:

```bash
cargo run --features cybercore --example cybercore
```

List available themes:

```bash
cargo run --features cybercore --example cybercore -- --list
```

Render a specific theme:

```bash
cargo run --features cybercore --example cybercore -- neon-night
```

The showcase covers:

* `TRACE`
* `DEBUG`
* `INFO`
* `WARNING`
* `ERROR`
* `FATAL`

## Testing Improvements

The renderer now has dedicated regression coverage for:

* Unicode box alignment
* Long message wrapping
* Long unbroken tokens
* Cause/note/help wrapping
* Long source-line clipping
* Highlight visibility
* Multiline source labels
* Theme ANSI output
* Global `color(false)` behavior
* Cybercore theme discovery
* Golden terminal output

The repository CI gate now includes strict Clippy checks with warnings treated as errors.

## Other Improvements

* Cleaner `CAUSE`, `NOTE`, and `HELP` presentation
* Improved metadata rendering
* Better variable naming and renderer internals
* Public crate documentation
* Updated README and changelog
* Improved package metadata
* `docs.rs` metadata added
* Renderer code formatted and Clippy-clean

## Feature Flags

### Compression

```bash
cargo test --features compression
```

Enables gzip and Zstandard support.

### Cybercore

```bash
cargo test --features cybercore
```

Enables Cybercore theme integration.

### Everything

```bash
cargo test --all-targets --all-features
```

## Upgrade Notes

There are no intentional breaking API changes from `v0.3.0`.

The main API addition is theme support through:

```rust
Reporter::builder()
    .theme(Theme::default())
```

Existing code that does not use themes should continue to work unchanged.

## What’s Next

The next development cycle will focus on integrations and richer diagnostic metadata, including:

* Dedicated `anyhow` integration
* More `thiserror` coverage
* `tracing` integration
* Improved `std::error::Error` adapters
* Custom diagnostic metadata
* Nonblocking / async output
* Additional renderers

Thanks for testing and pushing `diagprint` forward.
